svg.title: Unequal crossing over expands or contracts a tandem duplication
svg.desc: Four chromatids pass through normal pairing, mispairing and an exchange between nonsister chromatids. Products retain two, one, three and two repeat copies in source order. Hollow purple markers identify the source centromeres. Shared v2 bodies retain the original source centerlines and repeat overlays. L and R identify the left and right copies. The two inner chromatids exchange within misaligned repeats; white interruptions distinguish overlap from fusion.
svg.metadata: Original editable schematic constructed from instructor asset genetics/LECT11/djot/assets/lect11e-chromo_alter_2-duplications/image_002.png; source meaning and labels retained, geometry recomposed. Unmeasured chromosome lengths. 2026-11-09. Shared v2 chromosome-body migration 2026-11-15.
